newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Germany's DBBH offers HUF 35,000 for MKB "C" shrs.
newsitem.headline: Germany's DBBH offers HUF 35,000 for MKB "C" shrs.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Balaton Broker Holding AG (DBBH) on Wednesday made a buyout offer for the series "C" preference shares of Hungarian bank Magyar Kulkereskedelmi Bank Rt.

The buyout offer, made at 35,000 forints per share which have a face value of 10,000 forints each, is valid until May 16 and up to a nominal value of 17.9 million forints, Hungarian brokerage Elso Nemet Kft said in a statement.
Elso Nemet is 100 percent owned by DBBH.
If shares are delivered to Elso Nemet without dividend coupon, the offer prices is reduced by 1,950 forints, it said in a statement.
MKB is majority owned by Germany's Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale
